title: GUN KICK ON THE BODY
why: Idea I6 of the graphics list. p.recoil only moved the crosshair. The pixel body now steps its gun and shoulders back 1 art px on a shot, 2 for shotgun, magnum, sniper, dmr and lance, scaled by EFFECT INTENSITY (HALF keeps 1, OFF none). It reads the muzzle value so the linked window shows it too. Offset only, no new draw, no random draw.
now: Firing jolts the pixel gun and shoulders back a pixel or two.

edits.replacement: ty=y+dyUp; pxd=x+lean+rx-fl*(hold&&!dn&&!crouch?pxKick(muzzle,st.own&&st.own.wep&&st.own.wep.id):0); px=pxd; /* v28.xx (cw-gunkick) I6: the gun and shoulders jolt back 1 to 2 art px on a shot (muzzle reaches the linked window too) */
